messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change only the person's one-piece garment to match the reference images (front and back views). Preserve the garment's design, color, pattern, and fit as shown in the references. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first camera change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change only the person's one-piece garment to match the reference images. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands on a stone patio, slowly turning their body and head to look around the scene.","camera":"The camera is positioned at a low angle behind the subject, slowly dollying in and panning slightly to follow their movement.","clothing":"They wear a matching two-piece outfit in an orange, black, and white plaid pattern, consisting of a long-sleeved jacket with white cuffs and tapered trousers, along with dark flat sandals.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair is pulled up into a high, slightly messy bun.","identity":"A person with a slim build is seen from behind, with their face mostly hidden in shadow.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace overlooking a calm sea and rocky coastline under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The dark one-piece garment was replaced with an orange, black, and white plaid outfit. The output shows a long-sleeved jacket with white cuffs and matching tapered trousers, with a plaid pattern broadly similar to the references. The person's pose, hair, setting, and camera movement remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the person's one-piece garment to match the provided front and back reference images, preserving the reference garment's design, color, pattern, and fit while leaving the rest of the outfit and everything else unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the plaid pattern and fit closely match the reference images at full resolution.
unexpected_changes: The replaced garment appears as a two-piece jacket-and-trousers outfit rather than a single one-piece garment.
The reference front view's white shirt and black tie are not visible in the output.
The output framing includes black side bars, unlike the source framing.
